from service import score
import hashlib, uuid

class Store(dict):
    def __missing__(self, key):
        return None

def mk(job):
    return str(uuid.uuid4().hex) + '\n' + job

# 1. all three inputs affect caching: changing any input recomputes
s = {}
def compute():
    return compute.calls
compute.calls = 0
r1 = score(s, mk('a'), 'p1', 'c1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 0, compute.calls
r2 = score(s, mk('a'), 'p1', 'c1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 0 and r2 == r1

# change job_text
r3 = score(s, mk('b'), 'p1', 'c1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 1 and r3 != r1
# change profile
r4 = score(s, mk('a'), 'p2', 'c1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 2
# change criteria
r5 = score(s, mk('a'), 'p1', 'c2', compute)
assert compute.calls == 3

# 2. unchanged inputs reuse even None (None values and empty strings are valid inputs)
compute.calls = 0
base_key = 'J' + mk('n') + 'pNone\ncNone\n'
k = base_key
s[k] = None
assert k in s
r6 = score(s, k, 'pNone', 'cNone', compute)
assert compute.calls == 0 and r6 is None

# 3. no ambiguous concatenation keys: None and '' are distinct
k1 = mk('x') + '\0' + 'p\0c\0'
k2 = mk('x') + '\0' + ('p' + '') + '\0' + ('c' + '')
assert k1 != k2 or mk('x') + '\0' + 'pNone\0cNone\0' != mk('x') + '\0' + 'pNone\0cNone\0'
# ensure two different profiles/criteria produce different keys for same job
s['J' + mk('J') + 'profile1\0criteria1\0'] = None
s['J' + mk('J') + 'profile2\0criteria1\0'] = None
s['J' + mk('J') + 'profile1\0criteria2\0'] = None
assert len(s) == 3
score(s, 'J' + mk('J') + 'profile1\0criteria1\0', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 0
score(s, 'J' + mk('J') + 'profile1\0criteria2\0', 'profile1', 'criteria2', compute)
assert compute.calls == 0

# 4. changing compute-only input not allowed; but job_text/profile/criteria distinct
# use sentinel to confirm keys differ when text differs
t1, t2 = mk('u'), mk('v')
assert (t1 + 'p\0c\0') != (t2 + 'p\0c\0')

print('ALL OK')

from service import score

def compute():
    compute.calls += 1
    return compute.calls

compute.calls = 0
store = {}

# recompute only when any of job_text/profile_version/criteria_version changes
r1 = score(store, 'job-1', 'p1', 'c1', compute)
r2 = score(store, 'job-1', 'p1', 'c1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 1 and r2 == r1

# change job_text
assert score(store, 'job-2', 'p1', 'c1', compute) == 2
# change profile_version
assert score(store, 'job-1', 'p2', 'c1', compute) == 3
# change criteria_version
assert score(store, 'job-1', 'p1', 'c2', compute) == 4
# unchanged triple reuses
r5 = score(store, 'job-1', 'p1', 'c1', compute)
assert compute.calls == 4 and r5 == r1

# None, empty, and ambiguous-concatenation combos produce unique keys
keys = set()
for p in ('p1', 'p2', '', None):
    for c in ('c1', 'c2', '', None):
        k = str('job-1') + '\x00' + repr(p) + '\x00' + repr(c)
        keys.add(k)

assert len(keys) == 16

# empty string, None, and ambiguous concatenations stay distinct
store = {}
compute.calls = 0
job = 'J' + 'J'
store[job + '\x00' + 'p' + '\x00' + 'c'] = None
assert compute.calls == 0
assert score(store, job, 'p', 'c', compute) is None

# distinct combos of the same job with None vs '' vs real values remain separate keys
s2 = {}
compute.calls = 0
for p in ('p', '', None):
    for c in ('c', '', None):
        k = job + '\x00' + repr(p) + '\x00' + repr(c)
        s2[k] = compute()
        assert compute.calls == len(s2)
        score(s2, job, p, c, compute)
        assert compute.calls == len(s2)

print('ALL OK')
